newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two vehicle crashes in Mexico kill eighteen.
newsitem.headline: Two vehicle crashes in Mexico kill eighteen.

text.p: Fourteen people riding in the back of a pickup truck were killed when the vehicle crashed in central Mexico on New Year's day, media reports said on Thursday.
In a seperate accident, four people died when four tourist buses crashed on the main Mexico City-Acapulco highway, TV network Televisa said.
The truck veered off the Leon-Lagos de Moreno road in the state of Jalisco on Wednesday afternoon, state-owned news agency Notimex. Up to nine people were also injured, reports said.
TV images showed the front end of the truck completely destroyed at the side of a straight stretch of the highway. Police chief Ruben Torres told Televisa the truck was speeding.
In the other crash, four buses ran into each other close to the city of Cuernavaca in the state of Morelos en route to the famous Pacific coast resort of Acapulco, Televisa said.
It was not immediately clear when the bus accident occurred. The network said an unspecified number of passengers were also injured but no cause had been identified.
